acceptanceCriteria: Computed registrations are reported as UNRESOLVED with their location, never silently dropped.
A fixture covers one computed registration.
body: Residual from lane bf-1022q (PR beamfall/corvint#1547, seal 52f25c48d). Registrations whose key is computed at runtime (for example params.get(key)) are neither resolved nor reported, so the generated flow map silently omits them.
title: flowdocs: computed registrations such as params.get(key) are not handled
